🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION, as supplied. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive (Sector Strength), but Technology is positive over 1W and negative over 1M, while Communication is negative on both horizons; leadership is concentrated, not broad (3/5 Top Performers from Technology, across 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads on sector returns; UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) and ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) are ABOVE TREND. Real Estate is next by sector return (+1.23% 1W), with no constituent-level returns supplied; Energy is strong, with SLB (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.17%), XOM (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +12.99%) and CVX (1W: +3.65% | 1M: +13.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest (-2.23% 1W, -3.71% 1M): TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%) and T (1W: -10.71% | 1M: -16.83%) are BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary is down 0.76% 1W, with F (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%) and GM (1W: -9.58% | 1M: -5.77%) BELOW TREND; Industrials are nearly flat, with GE (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%) BELOW TREND despite LMT strength.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY; LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +8.95% | 1M: +14.18%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: concentrated, not broad (3/5 Technology; 3 sectors represented).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: F (1W: -6.68% | 1M: -7.94%), AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%), TMUS (1W: -7.89% | 1M: -11.38%), NEM (1W: -8.20% | 1M: -10.25%) and GE (1W: -8.98% | 1M: -10.54%) are all BELOW TREND. Weakness spans several sectors, with notable pressure in Technology and Communication.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +11.27% | 1M: -2.40%) RECOVERY, and LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND. Divergences include MSFT (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +5.34%) in CORRECTION and TSLA (1W: +4.93% | 1M: -1.51%) in RECOVERY; the broader major-stock divergence argues for a trend-break watch.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: sector return is +0.69% 1W but -0.95% 1M; stock-level positive counts were not supplied. NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) and IBM (1W: +9.23% | 1M: +11.67%) are ABOVE TREND, while MSFT (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +5.34%) is in CORRECTION and NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%), META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) and AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Financials Outlook?
Sector returns are modestly positive (+0.02% 1W, +1.37% 1M), with stock-level positive counts unavailable. Payments are firmer: V (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +10.85%) and MA (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +10.33%) are ABOVE TREND, while JPM (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -1.57%) is BELOW TREND; style remains mixed, not a clear Value/Cyclical lead.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Strongest sector by 1W return (+1.44%; +5.89% 1M), though constituent-level positive counts were not supplied. UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%), LLY (1W: +1.31% | 1M: +7.75%), PFE (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +5.70%) and ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) are ABOVE TREND; JNJ (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.54%) is in RECOVERY.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective strength in healthcare, energy and technology leaders, while reducing exposure to persistent laggards and avoiding broad style bets. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; major cross-horizon divergences make this a tactical opportunity, not a core-position signal.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND, if earnings momentum holds; NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, if gains consolidate. BEARISH: META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) and LRCX (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -25.09%), both BELOW TREND, if selling persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+1.44% 1W, +5.89% 1M) and Energy (+0.93% 1W, +11.03% 1M); overall breadth is 8/11 sectors positive, but sector-level constituent breadth was not provided. BEARISH: Communication (-2.23% 1W, -3.71% 1M) and Consumer Discretionary (-0.76% 1W), with downside persistence to monitor.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so price supports and resistance cannot be stated reliably. Monitor whether NVDA (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -6.06%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -9.40% | 1M: -17.36%) BELOW TREND stabilize, and whether NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND sustains its advance.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+55): beat-and-raise quarter; UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. LMT (+50): earnings beat and F-35 deal; LMT (1W: +9.44% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND, confirming. SLB (+50): earnings beat as drilling rebounds; SLB (1W: +7.19% | 1M: +3.17%) ABOVE TREND, confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (-50): slower da Vinci growth; ISRG (1W: +6.00% | 1M: +13.21%) ABOVE TREND, a price/sentiment divergence to monitor. LRCX (-45): supply warning weighs on chip sentiment; LRCX (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -25.09%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. AMAT (-35): investor-day outlook criticism; AMAT (1W: -7.83% | 1M: -20.46%) BELOW TREND, confirming weakness.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION is the supplied regime, with style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth is 8/11 sectors positive, but leadership is concentrated. Relative strength sits in NOW (1W: +11.97% | 1M: +15.37%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +11.49%) ABOVE TREND. Monitor major-stock trend divergences and bearish ISRG sentiment against its still-positive price trend.
